requires: Level 78+; a piece of Bravaael's remains from the top floor of the Hollow Spire
unlock: On the Hollow Spire's top floor lie Bravaael's bones, labelled by three rival bestiaries at once. Its last trial asks what it was; answer with a word no tongue owns, and a scale comes loose for you.
secret: You must have been recorded as three different creature types by three separate identification spells or scholars.
notice: [Category: undefined. The oldest scale accepts you. Legendary class: Unclassed Wyrm-Heir.]
blurb: Follows Bravaael, the Shrouded Shade of Dragon, a thing neither Animal nor Beastman nor Devil: you inherit its refusal to fit any box.
features: Skill: No Box Holds Me
You count as whichever creature type is best for you, so effects that target a type work or fail at your choice.
Skill: Elder Breath
Once per short rest, you exhale a 90 foot cone of any damage type you choose, dealing 14d10 damage (Dex save for half).
Ultimate: Before the Categories
Once per long rest, you take an ancient wyrm shape for 1 minute: fly 120 feet, +2 AC, resistance to all damage, and claws that deal 4d10.
evolves: If you slay a creature that claims to be a true dragon, your typeless nature extends to allies you name.
cost: Healing and potions tailored to any race or type work on you at half strength, since nothing agrees what you are.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Kaleyr left on the top floor of the Ledger Spire
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's top floor a brass plaque bearing Kaleyr's name slowly slides off its wall. Let your own name slip from the ledger, then catch it again one floor down.
secret: You must have woken somewhere other than where you fell asleep seven times, without any teleport magic.
notice: [Position: uncertain. You have slipped free of the ledger. Legendary class: The Unmoored.]
blurb: Follows Kaleyr, the Hidden Shade of Drift, who let things slide quietly from where they belonged, like a boat whose rope was never tied.
features: Skill: Slow Slip
When you hit a creature, it drifts 15 feet in a direction you choose at the start of its next turn, and any area spell it holds moves 10 feet with it.
Skill: Out of Place
As a reaction when targeted, you were never quite there: the attack has disadvantage and you shift 15 feet.
Ultimate: Everything Slides
Once per long rest, for 1 minute chosen creatures and objects within 60 feet drift 20 feet per round where you choose, and your wild surges roll twice so you pick the result.
evolves: If you stand opposite whoever holds Anchor and both survive, you learn to choose when drifting stops.
cost: Anything you set down is 1d10 feet away when you next look for it.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Gnome's remains from the top floor of the Milestone Spire
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, a cracked clod of Gnome's remains sits in a field that never sees rain. Carry it down every stair without letting a drop of water touch it.
secret: You must have worked a full day in the fields without drinking.
notice: [Moisture: zero. The furrow drinks you in. Legendary class: Child of the Thirsty Furrow.]
blurb: Follows Gnome, spirit of Earth, through its driest fragment: the state that is Wet's opposite and Earth's quiet kin.
features: Skill: Parched Touch
As an action, your touch deals 1d6 necrotic damage and dries mud, puddles or a small fire away completely.
Skill: Cracked Ground
Once per short rest, you turn a 15 foot square of mud, marsh or shallow water into firm cracked earth; water creatures inside take 2d6 damage.
Ultimate: Drought Halo
Once per long rest, for 1 minute a 20 foot aura dries everything: enemies starting there take 2d6 necrotic and gain no benefit from potions.
evolves: At level 11, carrying the clod to Gnome's other remains can deepen this class into a true Earth heir.
cost: You need twice the normal water each day or gain a level of exhaustion.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Nydoeth's remains from the top floor of the Hollow Spire
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Nydoeth's headless mount still circles its rider's remains. The last trial: catch the skull it hurls at you without dropping it, and let it speak your name.
secret: You must have been beheaded or killed and then raised again by any means.
notice: [Head received. The rider rides again. Legendary class: Headbearer of the Pale Steed.]
blurb: Follows Nydoeth, the Twin-Faced Shade of Dullahan, rider of the dead who carried its own head instead of wearing it, like the headless horsemen of old roads.
features: Skill: Head in Hand
You can lift your head free and set it up to 300 feet away, seeing from it; you cannot be surprised, and losing your head cannot kill you.
Skill: Rider Who Does Not Stop
You summon a spectral steed with 90 feet of speed that ignores terrain and crosses water; mounted hits deal an extra 6d8 necrotic.
Ultimate: Name Called at the Door
Once per long rest, you call the name of a creature you can see: it makes a Con save or drops to 0 hit points, taking 14d10 necrotic on a success.
evolves: If a Death knight you raised from a worthy corpse rides beside you for a year, you become herald of the Void's dead.
cost: Gold burns you: you cannot hold or wear it, and gold weapons deal double damage to you.

requires: Level 100+; the trace Cosmic left on the top floor of the First Spire
unlock: On the First Spire's top floor, light and dark meet along a hairline Cosmic left behind. Stand on that seam for one full spire-dusk, which lasts a year, without stepping to either side.
secret: You must have been born, or returned from death, exactly at sunset.
notice: [Neither day nor night. The seam holds your weight. Legendary class: Keeper of the Brief Seam.]
blurb: Follows Cosmic, the Forgotten Shade of Dusk, keeper of the seam between Day and Night that most think too brief to claim.
features: Skill: Neither Hour
Effects tied to day, night, light or darkness have no hold on you, and you see perfectly through any light or magical darkness.
Skill: Twilight Mantle
Allies within 60 feet gain 20 temporary hit points at the start of each of their turns and cannot be frightened or charmed.
Ultimate: The Hour That Lasts
Once per long rest, you hold dusk over a mile for 1 minute: enemies cannot regain hit points or use light or dark powers, and allies' hits deal +6d10 radiant or necrotic.
evolves: If the holders of Day and Night both bow to you, your Hour can be held for a full hour.
cost: Each day between sunset and full dark you cannot speak or act, only watch.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Gnome left on the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: The top of the Horizon Spire is an endless plain with one footprint pressed into bare bedrock. Follow Gnome's trail of prints to where they stop, kneel, and listen until the ground speaks first.
secret: You must be of a spiritual bloodline such as Shaman or Elf, or have spoken with a land spirit.
notice: [Bloodline confirmed. The earth remembers its spirit. Legendary class: Deep-Root Bloodline.]
blurb: Follows Gnome, the Forgotten Shade of Earth, whose corpse became the Earth Law and still answers best to those with spirit in their blood.
features: Skill: Spirit-Fed Stone
Your earth spells and abilities deal +4d8 bludgeoning, and while you touch natural ground you gain +1 AC.
Skill: Quarry of the Spirit Realm
Once per short rest, the ground swallows creatures in a 40 foot radius: Dex save or take 10d10 bludgeoning and be restrained.
Ultimate: The Land Answers
Once per long rest, for 1 minute the ground within a mile is yours: each turn you shake it for 12d10 to chosen creatures, and allies cannot be knocked prone.
evolves: If you also reach Gnome's remains in the Unlit Spire, your bloodline wakes fully and Iron hears you.
cost: After a day away from bare earth, on ships or in the air, these features fade until you touch soil.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Iron's remains from the top floor of the Milestone Spire
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, Iron's rusted remains sit inside a broken clockwork. The last trial: rebuild it using only half the parts laid out for you.
secret: You must never have thrown away a tool or part that still worked.
notice: [Waste: none. Output doubled. Legendary class: Tinker of the Spare Bolt.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Nameless Shade of Efficiency, in the Mechanical law of doing more with less rather than guarding against failure.
features: Skill: Fewer Parts
Crafting and repairs cost you half the materials and half the time.
Skill: One Motion, Two Results
Once per short rest, when you attack or use an item, you also take the Use an Object or Help action for free.
Ultimate: Perfect Economy
Once per long rest, your next three uses of a class feature or 1st level spell cost no resource.
evolves: If something you build runs for a year with no waste and no repair, the class evolves into a full Mechanical heir.
cost: Backups fail you: spare weapons, second potions and redundant tools in your pack do not work.

requires: Level 45+; a piece of Rytaeth's remains from the top floor of the Sunken Spire
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Rytaeth's armour still stands upright, refusing to fall. Defeat it in a single joust, then refuse to bow to its corpse.
secret: You must not have apologised to anyone since your last birthday.
notice: [Self: unbowed. The armour finally kneels to you. Legendary class: Lance of the Unbowed Self.]
blurb: Follows Rytaeth, the Hidden Shade of Ego, whose Law sat closer to Pride than to Light or Dark: a rider who made itself the centre of every field.
features: Skill: I Am Here
Creatures within 15 feet have disadvantage attacking anyone but you, and you have advantage against charm and fear.
Skill: Unbowed Charge
Move up to 40 feet in a straight line and attack: the hit deals +8d8 and knocks the target prone.
Ultimate: Center of the World
Once per long rest, every hostile creature within 120 feet makes a Wis save or can attack only you for 1 minute; you take half damage from them.
evolves: If you are beaten and still refuse to yield, the class evolves toward Pride.
cost: You can never accept help gracefully: healing from others restores only half.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Eirzen's remains from the top floor of the Hollow Spire
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Eirzen's armour lies stretched across the void like a skin. The last trial: let it return every blow you have ever dealt, and remain standing.
secret: You must have been dropped to 0 hit points by one blow and returned to fight in the same battle.
notice: [Breaking point: not found. You bend and return. Legendary class: The Unsnapping.]
blurb: Follows Eirzen, the Shrouded Shade of Elastic, who bent under every hit instead of breaking.
features: Skill: Give and Return
When hit, reduce the damage by 4d10 and store it; your next hit adds the stored amount.
Skill: Long Line
Your melee reach becomes 30 feet and bends around corners, and a hit can pull the target to you.
Ultimate: Rebound Absolute
Once per long rest, for 1 minute damage beyond half your hit points is stored instead of taken, then released as force in a 30 foot radius (max 20d10).
evolves: If you take a god's blow without breaking, you can stretch your protection over your allies.
cost: Rigid gear rejects you: plate armour and shields give you no benefit.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Sylph left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: On the Heartwood Spire's top floor, one ring still crackles where Sylph passed through. Hold your palm on it until the static has travelled every ring of the trunk and back.
secret: You must have survived a strike of natural lightning.
notice: [Current found. No god's blood required. Legendary class: Sparkvein Stormcaller.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, the Twin-Faced Shade of Electric, Lightning's smaller cousin that a mortal can hold without divine blood.
features: Skill: Live Wire
Your melee hits deal +4d8 lightning that leaps to a second creature within 10 feet.
Skill: Static Tide
While raging or concentrating, creatures that start their turn within 15 feet take 4d10 lightning, and foes in metal armour have disadvantage against you.
Ultimate: Current Without a God
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you move 60 feet along metal or water as a bonus action, and every hit chains to four creatures for 10d8 lightning.
evolves: If you call true Lightning without a god's blood, the class becomes a full storm heir.
cost: Water betrays you: entering deep water deals 4d8 lightning to you.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Osttaur left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, the rings weep sap into a cradle Osttaur left behind. Feel the grief of every climber who died in the tower, then choose to climb down anyway.
secret: You must have wept for an enemy you killed.
notice: [Another's heart, carried. Legendary class: Bearer of Borrowed Tears.]
blurb: Follows Osttaur, the Weeping Heart of Empathy, who carried other people's feelings as a splinter of Light.
features: Skill: Carried Ache
As a reaction, you take half the damage dealt to an ally within 60 feet.
Skill: Shared Heart
Link up to six creatures; each uses the highest saving throw bonus among them.
Ultimate: Every Heart at Once
Once per long rest, creatures within 120 feet feel what you feel: enemies make a Wis save or are incapacitated by sorrow for 1 minute, and allies regain 10d10 hit points.
evolves: If you carry the feeling of a god and return it, the class evolves into a mediator of the Divine.
cost: When an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, you gain a level of exhaustion.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Ishnoael left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: On the Heartwood Spire's top floor, a ring is missing from the trunk, a hollow Ishnoael left. Step into the gap and sit for seven days thinking of nothing.
secret: You must enter the tower owning nothing at all.
notice: [Space removed. You stand where nothing is. Legendary class: Monk of the Unfilled Room.]
blurb: Follows Ishnoael, the Twin-Faced Shade of Emptiness, Zero's cousin, who lived in the nothing where something should be.
features: Skill: Nothing Here
You can pass through creatures, and attacks against you in dim light have disadvantage.
Skill: Unmade Distance
As a bonus action, you remove the space between two points and appear up to 60 feet away.
Ultimate: Room Without Space
Once per long rest, a 30 foot sphere becomes absent space for 1 minute: creatures inside cannot move or breathe and take 10d10 force each turn.
evolves: If you meet Zero's holder in silence, you can empty spells as well as space.
cost: You can carry no more than fits in your two hands.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Braniane's remains from the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: On the Shuffled Spire's top floor, Braniane's corpse lies beneath a table of half-finished items whose enchantments shuffle every hour. Finish one before the room changes.
secret: You must have made or attuned an item that later destroyed itself.
notice: [Law bound to object. The keeper is born again in your work. Legendary class: Runesmith of the Second Birth.]
blurb: Follows Braniane, the Twice-Born Keeper of Enchantment, who bound Laws into objects so even those without godhood could wield a sliver.
features: Skill: Law into Object
During a short rest, bind a Law you have touched into an item: +1 to hit or +1 AC (max +2 total), or a 3d8 damage rider.
Skill: Second Birth
Items you made reform after a short rest when destroyed.
Ultimate: Armory of Laws
Once per long rest, every item you made within 60 feet awakens for 1 minute and strikes on your turn for 6d8 force each.
evolves: If something you made is wielded by a new god, the class evolves into a maker of Runes.
cost: Each enchantment takes a piece of you: your maximum hit points drop by 1 per active item.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Life left on the top floor of the Ledger Spire
unlock: The Ledger Spire's top plaque bears no debt, only a closing line Life left half written. Write the last line of your own ledger beneath it and live by it.
secret: You must have finished every quest you ever began.
notice: [Account closed. Legendary class: Clerk of the Final Line.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Shrouded Shade of End, through the Law that opposes Beginning and belongs to the Void, not to Death.
features: Skill: Closing Line
When you hit a creature that has 15 hit points or fewer, it drops to 0.
Skill: Last Page
Once per short rest, you end one spell or effect within 60 feet with no check.
Ultimate: The End of This
Once per long rest, you end one fight, curse or journey: combatants make a Wis save or stop fighting for 1 hour, and a curse simply ends.
evolves: If you find whoever holds Beginning, you can close one thing and open another in the same breath.
cost: Anything you begin ends early: your buffs and spells last half as long.

requires: Level 12+; the trace Life left on the top floor of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: On the Fogglass Spire's top floor, a candle Life left has been burning down for centuries. Sit with it until it gutters out, and do not relight it.
secret: You must have sat at the bedside of someone dying of old age.
notice: [The wick is spent. Endings come slowly to your hand. Legendary class: Winder of Long Things.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Twin-Faced Shade of Ending, who wound whole things down gently rather than stopping them.
features: Skill: Winding Down
Creatures you hit lose 10 feet of speed and take -1 to attacks, stacking to -3.
Skill: Slow Last Breath
Your conditions on enemies last until they finish a long rest unless removed.
Ultimate: The Long Goodbye
Once per long rest, a creature you touch makes a Con save or can take only one action per turn and loses 4d10 hit points each turn for 1 minute.
evolves: If you watch a whole kingdom end in peace, the class sharpens into End.
cost: Your own gear wears out: nonmagical items break after a month.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Cosmic left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: On the Heartwood Spire's top floor, one ring glows with power not yet shaped into any Law, Cosmic's trace. Hold it a full day without letting it become fire, stone or anything at all.
secret: You must have run completely dry of spells and features in a battle and kept fighting.
notice: [Power: unshaped. Capacity: unlimited. Legendary class: The Raw Reserve.]
blurb: Follows Cosmic, the Unknown Shade of Energy, the raw capacity to do anything before it is shaped into something.
features: Skill: Unshaped Power
Your damaging spells can deal force instead, and once per short rest you regain a spell slot of up to 5th level.
Skill: Before Shape
Unused spell slots at a long rest become charges (max 5) you can spend later as slots.
Ultimate: The Capacity to Do Anything
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cast one spell you know of 7th level or lower each turn without a slot.
evolves: If you shape your energy into Plasma under a cosmic sky, the class evolves.
cost: Unshaped energy leaks: when you roll a natural 1, you take 4d10 force.

requires: Level 89+; a piece of Dramiur's remains from the top floor of the Unlit Spire
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Dramiur's remains have decayed into drifting dust. The last trial: let the dust try to unmake you, and remember what you are as the floors below are forgotten.
secret: You must have watched something you built fall apart and chosen not to repair it.
notice: [All things unravel. You unravel them faster. Legendary class: Herald of the Slow Unraveling.]
blurb: Follows Dramiur, the Unbound Shape of Entropy, the Void's slow law of things falling apart without Destruction's help.
features: Skill: Things Fall Apart
Creatures you damage lose 2d10 maximum hit points until a long rest, and objects and constructs take double damage.
Skill: Rust of Ages
Enemies within 60 feet lose 1 AC each round (max -2), and their nonmagical weapons break on a natural 1.
Ultimate: Heat Death
Once per long rest, a 60 foot sphere unravels for 1 minute: 16d10 necrotic each round, no healing inside, and structures crumble.
evolves: If you let a god's work decay without lifting a hand, you become entropy's chosen.
cost: Your wounds never fully close: resting restores at most half your hit points.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Thalshaor's remains from the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Thalshaor's corpse clutches a lamp it stole. Each hour the trial offers a finer lamp in someone else's hand; take only Thalshaor's.
secret: You must have stolen something you did not need only because someone else had it.
notice: [Want acknowledged. What is theirs can be yours. Legendary class: Coveter of the Next Lamp.]
blurb: Follows Thalshaor, the Unquiet Heart of Envy, a splinter of Dark shaped by wanting what others have, like the lamp-bound spirits of old bazaars.
features: Skill: What You Have
Once per short rest, you take a creature's resistance or one prepared spell until your next short rest.
Skill: Green Eye
Against creatures with more hit points or levels than you, you have advantage and deal +6d8.
Ultimate: Their Life Is Mine
Once per long rest, swap your current hit points or one special ability with a creature you touch for 1 minute.
evolves: If your envy turns to wanting more of everything, the class evolves toward Greed.
cost: When an ally gains a magic item before you, you must pass a Wis save or try to take it.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Undine left on the top floor of the Ledger Spire
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's top floor, one brass plaque has been worn smooth by a single drip, Undine's trace. Stand under it until the drip wears your own name off the brass.
secret: You must have waited a month to finish something you could have done by force.
notice: [Grain by grain, it is done. Legendary class: Patient Tidecarver.]
blurb: Follows Undine, the Hidden Shade of Erosion, water wearing down earth one grain at a time, patient where Lava and Storm never are.
features: Skill: Grain by Grain
Each hit on the same target lowers its AC by 1 (max -2) and adds +1d6 to your next hit on it.
Skill: Canyon Cut
Once per short rest, a 60 foot line of water deals 6d8 bludgeoning and wears away stone walls in its path.
Ultimate: The Patient Sea
Once per long rest, choose a creature or structure: for 1 minute it loses 4d10 hit points each round with no save, and its AC drops by 2.
evolves: If you wear down a mountain in your lifetime, Undine's deeper trace opens to you.
cost: You cannot hurry: you cannot Dash or take bonus action movement.

requires: Level 45+; the trace Seltheur left on the top floor of the Sunken Spire
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire lies a grey pebble that is all that remains of something, Seltheur's trace. Let the pressure strip your powers away one by one, and stay.
secret: You must once have lost all your powers to a curse or antimagic and survived.
notice: [Laws stripped. Existence proven. Legendary class: Witness of What Remains.]
blurb: Follows Seltheur, the Quiet Shade of Essence, what is left of a spirit or god once even its Laws are gone.
features: Skill: Proof It Existed
You sense remains of dead gods and spirits nearby, and effects that would erase, banish or disintegrate you leave you at 1 hit point instead.
Skill: Stripped Bare
As an action, a creature you touch makes a Con save or loses its spells and magical abilities until your next turn.
Ultimate: Only Proof Remains
Once per long rest, nothing within 60 feet works but bodies for 1 minute: no spells, features or magic items, and you gain +2 AC and a third attack.
evolves: If you hold the essence of a dead god, you may ask it one question.
cost: You are inert: you cannot cast spells or use magic items other than weapons and armour.

requires: Level 78+; the trace Infinatas left on the top floor of the Hollow Spire
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Infinatas left a footprint from before he was a god. Guard the Runes' glow beside it for what the spire calls forever, which ends only when you admit nothing lasts.
secret: You must have outlived everyone you once knew.
notice: [Duration: unknown. You remain. Legendary class: Watcher of the Last Candle.]
blurb: Follows Infinatas, the Forgotten Shade of Eternal, through a Law almost nothing claims, since even he was not always a god.
features: Skill: Not Yet
Once per short rest, when reduced to 0 hit points you drop to 1 instead, and you no longer age.
Skill: Lasting Work
Your spells of 1 minute last 1 hour, and nothing you build decays.
Ultimate: For As Long As It Holds
Once per long rest, choose one thing: a wall, an oath or a creature's life. It cannot end for 1 hour.
evolves: If you keep one promise for a thousand years, Eternal claims you outright.
cost: Allies forget your name after a week apart from you.

requires: Level 100+; a piece of Eurus's remains from the top floor of the First Spire
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Eurus's remains drift as a warm spiral of wind around a seed. The last trial: walk the spiral inward against the gale, carrying someone you love who is dying, and ask for them to live.
secret: You must have tried to bring someone back from death and failed.
notice: [The east wind turns back for you. Legendary class: Wind That Sought the Mother.]
blurb: Follows Eurus, the deity who held both Vortex and Life after seeking Infinatas to save her mother.
features: Skill: Gale of Return
A 30 foot vortex surrounds you: enemies are pushed 20 feet and allies inside regain 4d10 hit points at the start of their turns.
Skill: Breath to the Dying
Once per short rest, a creature dead less than 1 minute returns with 50 hit points while the vortex deals 20d10 to enemies near it.
Ultimate: The Eastern Wind Turning
Once per long rest, a mile-wide vortex deals 20d10 to chosen enemies each round for 1 minute, heals allies fully once, and returns one creature dead less than a day.
evolves: If you reach Infinatas and ask what Eurus asked, his answer changes the class.
cost: Each life you return costs you a year of your own.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Eirtaix's remains from the top floor of the Ledger Spire
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Eirtaix's corpse is a heap of half-changed bodies chained to a plaque reading paid in full. Change one part of yourself forever, and never take it back.
secret: You must have survived a curse or polymorph that lasted more than a month.
notice: [Change: permanent. Legendary class: Shape That Stays Changed.]
blurb: Follows Eirtaix, the Shrouded Shade of Evolve, who changed things for good rather than for a moment.
features: Skill: Adapted
After taking one damage type three times, you gain permanent resistance to it (max three types).
Skill: New Limb
Grow one permanent trait: claws (2d8), gills, or wings that fly 30 feet; gain another each stage.
Ultimate: Leap of a Thousand Generations
Once per long rest, you evolve for 1 hour: Large size, +2 AC, +4d8 on every hit, and immunity to one damage type you name.
evolves: Every stage you reach, the class itself grows a new trait the DM chooses.
cost: You can never change back: polymorph, wild shape and disguises fail on you.

requires: Level 12+; a piece of Ostleune's remains from the top floor of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, half the room is not there, and only Ostleune's remains are solid. The last trial: name every object in the mist aloud until it becomes real, then name the corpse.
secret: You must have been called unreal by an illusion, a double or an erased record, and refused it.
notice: [Existence confirmed. Legendary class: Affirmer of the Real.]
blurb: Follows Ostleune, the First Shape of Existence, the Void's broadest Law of simply being real, opposed only by Deletion.
features: Skill: I Am Real
You have advantage against illusions and see invisible creatures within 30 feet.
Skill: This Is
Once per short rest, your touch ends an illusion or forces a shapechanger into its true form (Wis save).
Ultimate: Order of Being
Once per long rest, for 1 minute nothing false exists within 30 feet: illusions end, teleports fail, and summoned creatures make a Cha save or vanish.
evolves: If you stand against Deletion and remain, the class becomes the Void's witness.
cost: You are too real to hide: you cannot lie or be disguised.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Hashaas left on the top floor of the Unlit Spire
unlock: The top of the Unlit Spire holds a trial built to be failed, its wall scratched with Hashaas's endless tally of attempts. Fail it a hundred times in a row and still try a hundred and first.
secret: You must have failed a job change quest, or rolled fifty natural 1s the DM has tracked.
notice: [Failure recorded. Failure accepted. Legendary class: Patron of the Missed Mark.]
blurb: Follows Hashaas, the Shrouded Shade of Failure, the common outcome for anyone reaching past their Aptitude.
features: Skill: Failing Forward
Each roll you fail gives +2 to your next roll, stacking to +10 until you succeed.
Skill: Spread the Miss
Three times per short rest, as a reaction, force a creature within 60 feet to reroll a success and keep the lower result.
Ultimate: Everyone Falls Short
Once per long rest, for 1 minute enemies within 120 feet treat any d20 roll of 10 or lower as a natural 1.
evolves: If you finally succeed at the trial that made you, the class turns toward Success.
cost: Your own natural 20s count as 19s.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Sylph's remains from the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Sylph's remains are a feather that has been falling down the hollow trunk forever. The last trial: step off and fall the whole height without grabbing anything, and catch it before you land.
secret: You must have survived a fall of 500 feet or more.
notice: [Flight interrupted. Fall resumed. Legendary class: Plummet-Born.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, the Nameless Shade of Fall, the plain end of everything Flight only briefly interrupted.
features: Skill: Gravity's Grip
You take no falling damage, and creatures you hit lose any flight until your next turn.
Skill: Long Drop
Leap 120 feet up and crash down, dealing 10d10 bludgeoning in a 20 foot radius.
Ultimate: Everything Comes Down
Once per long rest, for 1 minute nothing within a mile can fly or levitate, and creatures that fall take double damage.
evolves: If you bring down a flying god, the class evolves into Gravity's herald.
cost: You can never fly, glide or levitate by any means.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Karin left on the top floor of the Unlit Spire
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, a door claims to be a wall and every surface carries Karin's lies. Find the one true thing on the floor by telling a lie that is also true.
secret: You must have kept a lie believed for at least a year.
notice: [Truth value: false. Legendary class: Root of the Untrue.]
blurb: Follows Karin, the Hidden Shade of False, the root Law beneath both Illusion and Lies.
features: Skill: That Isn't So
Three times per short rest, as a reaction, call a hit, miss or save false: it is rerolled.
Skill: Grafted Falsehood
Your illusions can deal 16d6 psychic damage and physically block movement.
Ultimate: The World Is Lying
Once per long rest, declare one thing within 300 feet false: a wall vanishes for 1 minute, or a creature makes a Cha save or drops to 0 hit points (20d10 psychic on a success).
evolves: If you tell a god a lie it believes, the class evolves past Illusion.
cost: No one quite believes you: disadvantage on Persuasion even when you speak truly.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Brarios's remains from the top floor of the Hollow Spire
unlock: At the top of the soundless Hollow Spire, Brarios's remains are a statue no one can see because no one is looking. The last trial: duel before an audience of echoes until the silent tower notices you.
secret: Your name must be known in at least three cities.
notice: [You have been noticed. Legendary class: Blade Everyone Watches.]
blurb: Follows Brarios, the Forgotten Shade of Fame, a Law shaped by the Mortal Realm noticing someone.
features: Skill: All Eyes
While any creature watches you, your weapon hits deal +6d8.
Skill: Name Precedes You
Enemies who have heard of you make a Wis save when combat begins or are frightened for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Legend Told Mid-Fight
Once per long rest, for 1 minute each creature that can see you adds 1d10 to your hits (max 20d10), and you cannot drop below 1 hit point while watched.
evolves: If a song about you outlives you, the class passes to whoever sings it best.
cost: You cannot hide: Stealth has disadvantage, and rumours tell enemies where you are.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Ostvaos's remains from the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Ostvaos's corpse is a burnt heart that makes every climber flee. The last trial: hold it while every fear you have ever had plays out, and do not run.
secret: You must have run from a fight once and come back to finish it.
notice: [Dread acknowledged. You are what others flee. Legendary class: Ember-Hearted Dread.]
blurb: Follows Ostvaos, the Burning Heart of Fear, raw dread siphoned from Dark, sharper and faster than Sadness.
features: Skill: Dread First
When combat begins, enemies within 60 feet make a Wis save or are frightened; you deal +6d8 to frightened creatures.
Skill: Faster Than Sorrow
You win all initiative ties and gain a second reaction each round.
Ultimate: Burning Heart of Terror
Once per long rest, creatures within 120 feet make a Wis save or flee for 1 minute, taking 12d10 psychic on any turn they do not.
evolves: If you make a god afraid, you become Fear's chosen patron rather than its servant.
cost: You are always a little afraid: disadvantage on saves against being frightened.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Vadoas left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Vadoas left a coffin half open in the heartwood. Lie in it until you are half alive and half not, then climb out choosing neither.
secret: You must have been raised by necromancy rather than true resurrection.
notice: [Status: alive and dead. Ratio unstable. Legendary class: The Halfway Returned.]
blurb: Follows Vadoas, the Strange Shade of Fext, a corpse caught halfway between summon and true return.
features: Skill: Half Here
You count as living or undead, whichever is better, and resist necrotic and radiant damage.
Skill: Unsteady Share
At the start of each turn roll a d6: your hits deal +2d10 (1-2), +6d10 (3-4) or +10d10 (5-6) necrotic.
Ultimate: Neither Grave Nor Breath
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you cannot die, and damage that would take you below 0 heals you instead.
evolves: If you choose a side for good, the class evolves toward the living or the dead for good.
cost: Once a day, at a moment the DM chooses, your heart stops and you lose your turn.

requires: Level 45+; the trace Kanoos left on the top floor of the Sunken Spire
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire is the dry cistern Kanoos once kept full. Fill it with something of your own, water, blood, song or life, until it overflows.
secret: You must have given away half your wealth to fill someone else's need.
notice: [Vessel full. Contents: you. Legendary class: Vessel That Pours.]
blurb: Follows Kanoos, the Forgotten Shade of Fill, opposite of Hollow, whose gift depended entirely on what was doing the filling.
features: Skill: Brim Over
Healing you give beyond a creature's maximum becomes temporary hit points.
Skill: Fill the Gap
Once per short rest, restore 8d10 hit points, regrow a lost limb, or fill a pit or breach up to 20 feet.
Ultimate: The Cup Runs Over
Once per long rest, allies within 60 feet are fully healed and freed of conditions, and hollow or void creatures take 16d10 radiant.
evolves: If you fill something Hollow's holder emptied, the pair evolve together.
cost: You never feel full: you need double food and water.

requires: Level 34+; the trace Morkaos left on the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: The Shuffled Spire's top floor never holds still, save for one chalk line Morkaos drew. Keep that line exactly in place for a full day while the floor reshuffles around it.
secret: You must have kept a vow with a hard limit to the exact count.
notice: [Boundary drawn. Legendary class: Measurer of Edges.]
blurb: Follows Morkaos, the Forgotten Shade of Finite, the Void law of limits, the boundary Infinite refuses to have.
features: Skill: Drawn Line
Draw a 60 foot line; creatures must pass a Str save to cross it until your next turn.
Skill: Counted
Any effect on you with no limit or duration lasts only 1 minute.
Ultimate: Everything Has an End Here
Once per long rest, a 100 foot dome for 1 minute: no regeneration, no resurrection, and enemies may use each feature only once.
evolves: If you draw a line Infinite cannot cross, the class becomes the Void's surveyor.
cost: You know your exact remaining lifespan in days and must count it each morning.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Selriix left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: The innermost ring of the Heartwood Spire's top floor bears Selriix's trace. Race every climber the tower remembers to touch it, and be first.
secret: You must have been the first to do something no one had ever done.
notice: [Rank: first. Legendary class: Holder of the Opening Step.]
blurb: Follows Selriix, the Strange Shade of First, a Law claimed constantly and rarely kept long.
features: Skill: Before Anyone
You always act first in initiative, and your first hit each combat is a critical hit.
Skill: First Claim
The first creature you hit each turn cannot take reactions until your next turn.
Ultimate: Ahead of Time
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you take an extra full turn at the start of every round.
evolves: If someone takes First from you and you win it back, you hold it for good.
cost: If anyone acts before you, you have disadvantage for the round.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Sylph's remains from the top floor of the Choir Spire
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire one voice is missing: Sylph's remains are a cracked bell. The last trial: mend the bell mid-song without breaking the rhythm.
secret: You must have repaired an item for an enemy.
notice: [Repair complete. The choir sings whole. Legendary class: Mender of the Broken Choir.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, the Hidden Shade of Fix, a narrow Stabilise meant for objects and wounds.
features: Skill: Patch Job
As a bonus action, restore 4d8 hit points to a creature or construct, or fully repair a small object.
Skill: Hold Together
Once per short rest, an ally reaching 0 hit points stays at 1, and broken items work for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Everything Mended
Once per long rest, every wound, construct and object of your allies within 60 feet is fully restored.
evolves: If you mend something a god broke, the class becomes a true Stabiliser.
cost: You must pass a Wis save to walk past anything broken without fixing it.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Life left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, a soft growth of Life's flesh heals and rots each hour. Let it rot your own flesh and regrow it seven times.
secret: You must have lost a limb and regrown it.
notice: [Flesh reshaped. Legendary class: Sculptor of Soft Clay.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Shrouded Shade of Flesh, the soft part of a body that Decay claims first.
features: Skill: Living Clay
As a bonus action, regain 6d10 hit points or grow an extra appendage until your next rest.
Skill: Flesh Before Bone
Your hits deal +6d8 necrotic to the living, and you can command undead made of flesh.
Ultimate: Body Unbound
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you regain 30 hit points each turn and can die only to fire or necrotic damage.
evolves: If you shape a body for a soul without one, the class evolves into a giver of form.
cost: Decay finds you first: necrotic damage against you is doubled.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Sylph's remains from the top floor of the Ledger Spire
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Sylph's feathers are nailed to a plaque reading owed: every flight. The last trial: pay the debt by stepping off the roof and flying back up without wings.
secret: You must never have flown by mount, spell or item before.
notice: [Debt paid. The sky is yours. Legendary class: Wingless Skywalker.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, the Quiet Shade of Flight, the Law most borrow from Air or Sylph's children instead of earning.
features: Skill: Earned Wind
You gain a flying speed of 60 feet.
Skill: Falcon Stoop
Diving at least 30 feet before a hit adds 6d8 and knocks the target prone.
Ultimate: The Sky Is Paid For
Once per long rest, allies within 60 feet gain your flying speed for 1 hour.
evolves: If you outfly one of Sylph's children, the class evolves toward Air.
cost: On the ground you are clumsy: your walking speed is halved.

requires: Level 45+; a piece of Mornieth's remains from the top floor of the Sunken Spire
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Mornieth's remains hang upside down from a floor that is a ceiling. The last trial: set one inverted room right without touching anything else in it.
secret: You must have turned an enemy into a friend, or a friend into an enemy.
notice: [State flipped. Legendary class: Turner of the Coin.]
blurb: Follows Mornieth, the Shrouded Shade of Flip, a small Void law that swaps a state for its opposite and nothing more.
features: Skill: Heads to Tails
As a reaction, end one condition on an ally within 30 feet and flip it onto an enemy within 30 feet (Wis save).
Skill: Reverse
Once per short rest, turn damage an ally takes into healing, or healing an enemy receives into damage.
Ultimate: Upside Down
Once per long rest, chosen creatures within 60 feet flip for 1 minute: their resistances become vulnerabilities and their highest and lowest scores swap.
evolves: If you flip a Law into its paired opposite, the class grows into a master of pairs.
cost: Left and right confuse you: disadvantage on navigation checks.

requires: Level 1+; the trace Ryvaos left on the top floor of the Milestone Spire
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, a field of flowers holds one bloom that has never closed, Ryvaos's trace. Pick it without bruising a petal and keep it alive for ten days.
secret: You must have grown a flower from seed yourself.
notice: [Bloom gathered. Legendary class: Garland Gatherer.]
blurb: Follows Ryvaos, the Quiet Shade of Flower, what Bloom leaves behind, prized by Alchemy and by anyone chasing Charm.
features: Skill: Petal Lore
You identify any plant and brew potions of healing (2d4+2) at half cost.
Skill: Charming Bloom
While wearing a fresh flower you have advantage on Persuasion, and once per long rest you can charm a creature for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Garden in Full Flower
Once per long rest, flowers bloom in 20 feet: allies regain 2d8 hit points and enemies make a Wis save or are charmed for 1 round.
evolves: At level 11, a garden you planted can evolve the class toward Bloom.
cost: Bees and hungry beasts follow you everywhere.

requires: Level 45+; a piece of Haran's remains from the top floor of the Sunken Spire
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, Haran's corpse bristles with weapons from every friend it turned. The last trial: duel an image of your closest friend and win.
secret: You must have been betrayed by a friend and declared them your foe.
notice: [Relation: hostile. Legendary class: Sworn Foe of All.]
blurb: Follows Haran, the Hidden Shade of Foe, Friend's opposite and the easier of the two to fake.
features: Skill: Marked Foe
Mark a creature: your hits deal +8d8 to it and you always know where it is.
Skill: False Friend
Feign friendship: a creature makes a Wis save or is charmed until you attack it, and that first attack is a critical hit.
Ultimate: Enemy of the World
Once per long rest, every creature within 120 feet becomes your foe for 1 minute: you gain +2 AC and one extra attack per three foes.
evolves: If a foe of yours becomes a true friend, the class evolves toward Friend.
cost: Help from allies lasts only half as long on you.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Sylph left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, the rings form a pattern with one ring missing where Sylph's trace lies. Complete the formation with your own Laws.
secret: You must have cast a spell together with another caster at the same moment.
notice: [Pattern aligned. Legendary class: Weaver of Aligned Laws.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, the Nameless Shade of Formations, the practice of arranging Laws so effects like Vortex can exist.
features: Skill: Lay the Pattern
Draw a 30 foot formation: allies inside gain +1 AC and +2 to saving throws.
Skill: Two Laws Line Up
Once per short rest, cast two spells as one action.
Ultimate: Grand Array
Once per long rest, a 300 foot formation fires for 1 minute, dealing 20d10 of two combined damage types to chosen enemies each round.
evolves: If you align Laws into Vortex or Apocalypse, the class rises to a master of formations.
cost: You must prepare a formation for 1 minute before combat or lose these features for that fight.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Life's remains from the top floor of the Ledger Spire
unlock: Among rotting debts on the Ledger Spire's top floor, Life's remains are an apple still fresh after centuries. The last trial: keep it fresh through the furnace heat of that floor for a day.
secret: You must have kept a body from decay until it could be properly buried.
notice: [Freshness preserved. Legendary class: Keeper of the Unspoilt.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Twin-Faced Shade of Fresh, the gentlest opposite of Decay, close to Preserve.
features: Skill: Ever-Fresh
You and allies within 30 feet are immune to disease and poison, and your food never spoils.
Skill: Ward of Spring
Once per short rest, a ward absorbs 6d8 plus your level in damage, doubled against necrotic.
Ultimate: Untouched by Time
Once per long rest, for 1 minute nothing decays within 30 feet: necrotic damage and aging fail, and undead take 10d8 radiant each turn.
evolves: If you halt a god's decay, the class grows into Preserve.
cost: Anything stale you eat poisons you.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Selrour left on the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, two cups sit on a table under strange stars, Selrour's trace. Share a meal honestly with an enemy until they choose to call you friend.
secret: You must have a friend who has stood by you for five years.
notice: [Bond: true. Legendary class: Honest Companion of the Road.]
blurb: Follows Selrour, the Nameless Shade of Friend, Foe's opposite and the harder Law to use honestly.
features: Skill: True Friend
You share senses with any friend you name and can teleport to their side once per short rest.
Skill: Never Alone
When an ally within 120 feet is hit, you can swap places and take the hit.
Ultimate: The Whole Road Together
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every friend within a mile uses your saves, deals +12d10 on hits and cannot drop below 1 hit point.
evolves: If a former foe dies protecting you, the class evolves into something Foe cannot touch.
cost: If you deceive a friend, you lose this class for a week.

requires: Level 100+; a piece of Sylph's remains from the top floor of the First Spire
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Sylph's remains are burning wind still wound around Spin. The last trial: let two Laws pour into you at once and come out as one.
secret: You must have touched or held at least two Runes.
notice: [Fusion stable. Legendary class: Joiner of the First Pairs.]
blurb: Follows Sylph, the Shrouded Shade of Fusion, the act that made Vortex from Sylph and Spin.
features: Skill: Two Become One
Your damage combines two types and ignores resistance to either.
Skill: Fused Casting
Once per short rest, cast two spells as one combined spell that deals both effects.
Ultimate: The First Fusion
Once per long rest, fuse with a willing ally for 1 hour: combined hit points, both sets of features, and +20d10 on every hit.
evolves: If you fuse two Runes into a new Law, a new Tower may rise.
cost: After fusing, you share all pain with that ally for a day.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Time left on the top floor of the Ledger Spire
unlock: On the Ledger Spire's top floor, one plaque lists debts not yet incurred, Time's trace. Read your own future debt and pay it in advance.
secret: A prophecy about you must have come true.
notice: [Future glimpsed. Payment received. Legendary class: Reader of the Unwritten Ledger.]
blurb: Follows Time, the Shrouded Shade of Future, the face of Time hardest to bend because nothing has happened yet.
features: Skill: Next Moment
Three times per short rest, add a d10 to a roll after seeing it.
Skill: Foreseen
You cannot be surprised, and your reactions have advantage.
Ultimate: What Hasn't Happened
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you know every enemy action before it comes: attacks against you have disadvantage and you may reroll any d20.
evolves: If you change a future you foresaw, the class reaches toward Time itself.
cost: Once a week you foresee your own death in vivid detail.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Liotan's remains from the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Liotan's corpse sits over a board game. The last trial: sacrifice your strongest piece as your first move, and still win.
secret: You must have won a fight by deliberately taking a hit.
notice: [Opening accepted. Legendary class: Opening-Move Duelist.]
blurb: Follows Liotan, the Hidden Shade of Gambit, a Gamble made on purpose as an opening, not from desperation.
features: Skill: Sacrificed Pawn
When you let an attack hit you, your next attack is a critical hit.
Skill: Planned Risk
Before an attack, call a bet: on a hit deal double damage, on a miss lose your next action.
Ultimate: The Board Was Mine
Once per long rest, take three full turns in the first round of combat.
evolves: If your gambit topples a god, the class evolves into Chaos's tactician.
cost: You can never play safe: you cannot Dodge or Disengage.

n: Carrion Lord of the Tainted Field
requires: Level 56+; the trace Ryleix left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: A ring of black rot marks where Ryleix lay at the top of the Heartwood Spire. Sleep there for a week on tainted ground without dying.
secret: You must have eaten a fallen foe to survive.
notice: [Taint absorbed. Legendary class: Carrion Lord of the Tainted Field.]
blurb: Follows Ryleix, the Shrouded Shade of Ghast, a Ghoul made worse by tainted ground, its stench a weapon on its own.
features: Skill: Stench Mantle
Creatures that start their turn within 15 feet make a Con save or are poisoned.
Skill: Paralyzing Claw
Your hits deal +6d8 necrotic, and the target makes a Con save or is paralyzed for 1 round.
Ultimate: Taint the Ground
Once per long rest, 300 feet of ground becomes tainted for 1 minute: enemies take 10d10 poison each turn and allied undead regain 20 hit points.
evolves: If you rot a holy ground, the class deepens toward the Abyss.
cost: Your stench gives disadvantage on Persuasion and sends beasts fleeing.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Morleyr left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, gnawed bones and claw marks are all Morleyr left. Hunt the tower's own hunter and keep a tenth of what you take.
secret: You must have outwitted a predator stronger than you.
notice: [Predator registered. Legendary class: Hunger-Cunning Stalker.]
blurb: Follows Morleyr, the Unknown Shade of Ghoul, a half-decayed corpse that kept a tenth of its power and a predator's cunning.
features: Skill: A Tenth Kept
When you kill a creature, gain a tenth of its maximum hit points as temporary hit points and one of its traits until a long rest.
Skill: Predator's Cunning
Attacks against creatures that have not seen you have advantage and deal +6d8.
Ultimate: Feast on the Fallen
Once per long rest, devour a corpse to gain its features and attacks for 1 hour.
evolves: If you eat the corpse of a hero, the class evolves into something worse.
cost: You must eat raw meat every day or gain a level of exhaustion.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Ostraur left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, a wooden hand reaches out where Ostraur left its trace. Give it everything you carry, and accept nothing back.
secret: You must have freely given away a magic item or a level.
notice: [Gift accepted. Legendary class: Open-Handed Giver.]
blurb: Follows Ostraur, the Shrouded Shade of Gift, the willing version of Take, power or Life handed over rather than pulled.
features: Skill: Handed Over
As a bonus action, transfer up to 50 of your hit points to a creature within 60 feet.
Skill: Gift of Power
Give an ally one of your spell slots or feature uses until your next rest.
Ultimate: The Whole Gift
Once per long rest, give an ally all your features and an extra full turn each round for 1 minute.
evolves: If someone you gave to gives it all back, the class completes its circle.
cost: Healing others give you restores only half.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Aelsaos's remains from the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Aelsaos's small remains lie under strange stars, still wearing a crown of daisies. The last trial: play the game she was playing when she died, and finish it.
secret: You must have kept a promise you made as a child.
notice: [Youth preserved. Legendary class: Daisy-Crowned Ever-Young.]
blurb: Follows Aelsaos, the Twin-Faced Shade of Girl, a category tied to Youth rather than any Law, like the spring maidens of village songs.
features: Skill: Youth Unspent
You no longer age and have advantage on saves against exhaustion.
Skill: Skipping Stone
Your movement provokes no opportunity attacks, and you can move across water or treetops.
Ultimate: Child of the Spring
Once per long rest, you and allies within 60 feet are made young again for 1 minute: full hit points and one expended feature each restored.
evolves: If you pass the crown to a child who earns it, the class evolves toward Youth.
cost: Officials and elders rarely take you seriously: disadvantage on Persuasion with them.

requires: Level 100+; a piece of Iron's remains from the top floor of the First Spire
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Iron's remains are unmoving stone with a glaive driven through. The last trial: pull it free and keep it from overbalancing as the spire tilts around you.
secret: You must have won a fight with a polearm in a narrow place.
notice: [Reach confirmed. Balance: none. Legendary class: Warden of the Long Edge.]
blurb: Follows Iron, the Shrouded Shade of Glaive, a shape trading Dagger's speed for Spear's reach and neither's balance.
features: Skill: Reach and Edge
Your reach increases by 10 feet and your polearm hits deal +8d12.
Skill: Rallying Sweep
Once per short rest, strike every enemy within reach, and allies who see it gain 30 temporary hit points.
Ultimate: The Unbalanced Arc
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every attack hits every enemy in your reach for +20d10.
evolves: If you return the glaive to Iron, it reforges to your hand.
cost: When you miss, attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

requires: Level 12+; a piece of Ulvais's remains from the top floor of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Ulvais's remains are a vast open jaw at a banquet table. The last trial: eat everything the fog serves for a whole night and still be hungry at dawn.
secret: You must have won an eating contest.
notice: [Hunger: endless. Legendary class: Bottomless Maw.]
blurb: Follows Ulvais, the Restless Heart of Gluttony, Desire that never knows it has been satisfied.
features: Skill: Devour
You gain a bite that deals 2d10 piercing, and you regain hit points equal to the damage.
Skill: Swallow Whole
Once per short rest, swallow a Medium or smaller grappled creature, which takes 4d6 acid each turn.
Ultimate: Never Full
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every hit heals you for its damage and grows you a size, to Huge.
evolves: If you eat a piece of a god's remains, the class deepens into a true Original Sin.
cost: You need triple food each day or gain a level of exhaustion.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Gnome's remains from the top floor of the Milestone Spire
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor, a pebble of Gnome's remains lies in a ploughed furrow. The last trial: hold it still in your palm for a full day while the tower hums around you.
secret: You must have stayed in one spot for a full day by choice.
notice: [Stillness confirmed. Legendary class: Pebble of the Old Root.]
blurb: Follows Gnome, the progenitor spirit of Earth, older than the small folk who share its name, slow and patient to the point of stillness.
features: Skill: Slow Stone
If you have not moved this turn, you gain +1 AC.
Skill: Rooted
You cannot be pushed or knocked prone while touching the ground.
Ultimate: Little Mountain
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
evolves: Carry the pebble to the Unlit Spire and the class can evolve into Patient Mountain.
cost: Your walking speed is reduced by 10 feet.

requires: Level 100+; the trace Quoniar left on the top floor of the First Spire
unlock: At the top of the First Spire, Quoniar left a locked chest of Laws no one else can touch. Open it without taking anything out.
secret: You must hold a contract of 1st Finger with a god.
notice: [Sole holder recognised. Legendary class: Hoarder of Sole Laws.]
blurb: Follows Quoniar, the Twin-Faced Shade of God-Specific Runes, keeper of Runes only one god can hold.
features: Skill: Only Mine
One Law you hold cannot be stolen, copied or suppressed.
Skill: Unbroken Hold
You are immune to effects that strip or drain your powers or Runes.
Ultimate: Laws No One Else Can Reach
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you wield one Law of a god you are contracted to as that god would, dealing 20d10 on hits.
evolves: If a god leaves you a Law in its will, it becomes yours alone.
cost: Gods covet what you hold: their servants hunt you across realms.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Eirsaos left on the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, a measuring stone with no top mark bears Eirsaos's trace. Let it grade you, then refuse the result.
secret: You must have been graded the lowest in some Aptitude assessment.
notice: [Grade: rejected. Legendary class: Assessor Beyond the Scale.]
blurb: Follows Eirsaos, the Twin-Faced Shade of Grade, the mortal ranking of Aptitude that means nothing to the gods.
features: Skill: Read the Grade
You see the level, Aptitude and current hit points of any creature you look at.
Skill: Off the Scale
Effects that check level, grade or rank treat you as whichever is best for you.
Ultimate: Regrade
Once per long rest, for 1 minute an enemy is treated as 10 levels lower (disadvantage on all rolls) or an ally as 10 levels higher (advantage).
evolves: If you grade a god and it accepts your mark, the class evolves.
cost: Gods ignore you: you cannot hold divine contracts above Minor.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Gravity's remains from the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: On the Shuffled Spire's top floor, Gravity's remains are a stone every other floor falls toward. The last trial: stand on it while the tower collapses into you, and remain upright.
secret: You must have survived being crushed.
notice: [Mass accepted. Legendary class: Inward-Pulling Sage.]
blurb: Follows Gravity, the First Shape of Gravity, the Void's weightlessness turned against itself until it pulled inward.
features: Skill: Heavier
Creatures you hit take +4d10 force and have their speed halved.
Skill: Well
Once per short rest, pull every creature within 20 feet of a point to it for 8d10 bludgeoning.
Ultimate: Collapse
Once per long rest, a 60 foot sphere falls inward for 1 minute: 14d10 force each round, and nothing inside can leave.
evolves: If you hold Fall and Flight at once, the class evolves to rule both.
cost: You are heavy: you cannot swim, and you sink.

requires: Level 89+; a piece of Morrath's remains from the top floor of the Unlit Spire
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Morrath's corpse lies buried in coins it forgot it had. The last trial: walk through the hoard and leave with exactly one coin.
secret: You must have owned 100,000 gold pieces at once.
notice: [Want more. Legendary class: Ever-More Blade.]
blurb: Follows Morrath, the Silent Heart of Greed, close kin to Envy, wanting more rather than wanting another's.
features: Skill: Take More
Each hit grants 2d10 temporary hit points, stacking to 150.
Skill: Never Enough
Each time you drop a creature, you make another attack.
Ultimate: Everything in Reach
Once per long rest, for 1 minute each hit steals a spell, item or feature from the target.
evolves: If you ever give everything away, the class turns into something else entirely.
cost: You must pass a Wis save to pay any price or give anything away.

requires: Level 45+; the trace Eirriis left on the top floor of the Sunken Spire
unlock: At the bottom of the Sunken Spire, a smiling mask full of ash marks Eirriis's trace. Name everyone you have lost aloud, smiling all the while.
secret: You must have buried someone with your own hands.
notice: [Grief carried lightly. Legendary class: Ash-Smile Mourner.]
blurb: Follows Eirriis, the Smiling Heart of Grief, the ash left after Sadness burns out.
features: Skill: Ash Veil
Allies within 30 feet cannot be frightened, and you see in any darkness.
Skill: Grey Respite
Once per short rest, allies within 30 feet gain 8d8 temporary hit points and end one condition.
Ultimate: Last Ember Smiles
Once per long rest, for 1 minute an ash sphere of 60 feet blinds enemies inside and heals allies 6d10 each turn.
evolves: If you help another mourner smile, the class evolves toward Hope.
cost: You cannot truly laugh: disadvantage on Performance meant to amuse.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Selraix's remains from the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Selraix's remains hang from a scythe sunk in the trunk. The last trial: collect every death the tower remembers before dawn.
secret: You must have killed a thousand creatures, tracked by the DM.
notice: [Deaths counted. Role assigned. Legendary class: Collector of the Thousandth Death.]
blurb: Follows Selraix, the Shrouded Shade of Grim Reaper, a role no one summons, grown into by collecting enough deaths.
features: Skill: Tally
You know how many creatures each being has killed, and your hits deal +6d8 necrotic to killers.
Skill: Reap
Once per short rest, a creature at half hit points or lower makes a Con save or dies.
Ultimate: Harvest of Souls
Once per long rest, for 1 minute each creature that dies within 120 feet heals you 20 and adds +1d10 to your hits.
evolves: At ten thousand deaths, you sit above every summon.
cost: You must end a life every day or lose these features until you do.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Zedour left on the top floor of the Unlit Spire
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, Zedour's trace is a contract already filled in. List every variable of the trial before acting; then the outcome is guaranteed.
secret: You must never have gambled.
notice: [Variables known. Outcome guaranteed. Legendary class: The Certain Hand.]
blurb: Follows Zedour, the Forgotten Shade of Guarantee, the Law usable only when every variable is known.
features: Skill: Known Variables
After studying a creature for 1 round, your attacks against it always hit.
Skill: Promised Outcome
Three times per short rest, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
Ultimate: It Will Happen
Once per long rest, declare one possible outcome in the next minute; if you know every variable, it happens.
evolves: If you guarantee an outcome Uncertain's holder opposes, the class becomes absolute.
cost: In surprise rounds or unknown places, you lose your first turn.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Selriyr's remains from the top floor of the Choir Spire
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Selriyr's remains repeat one hymn forever. The last trial: sing along a thousand times without one variation.
secret: You must have kept the same daily routine for a year without a break.
notice: [Repetition rewarded. Legendary class: Rote-Bound Penitent.]
blurb: Follows Selriyr, the Twin-Faced Shade of Habit, a Law that grows stronger each time it is used the same way.
features: Skill: Same Again
Repeating the same action as last turn gives +1 to hit and +1d8 damage, stacking to +5 and 5d8.
Skill: Ritual Strength
After a full day kept to routine, gain 30 temporary hit points at dawn.
Ultimate: The Perfect Repetition
Once per long rest, for 1 minute any action you repeat succeeds automatically.
evolves: If you keep a routine for ten years, it becomes unbreakable.
cost: Breaking routine costs all your stacks and gives disadvantage for a round.

requires: Level 67+; the trace Undine left on the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, ice falls from a cloud that never moves, Undine's trace. Catch one hailstone and keep it from melting all the way down.
secret: You must have hunted through a hailstorm.
notice: [Hail claimed. Legendary class: Stormstone Huntsman.]
blurb: Follows Undine, the Twin-Faced Shade of Hail, rain frozen mid fall, hard enough to bruise before it lands.
features: Skill: Hailstone Shot
Your ranged hits deal +6d8 cold and knock the target prone.
Skill: Barrage
Once per short rest, hail falls in a 40 foot radius for 12d10 bludgeoning.
Ultimate: Sky of Stones
Once per long rest, hail falls over a mile for 1 minute: 10d10 to chosen creatures each round and heavily obscured sight.
evolves: If you hunt a storm to its heart, the class evolves toward Storm.
cost: You are always cold: disadvantage on saves against cold.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Divine's remains from the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: On the Shuffled Spire's top floor, a ring of light lies on the floor where Divine fell. Wear it as the floor turns, keeping it level above your head.
secret: You must have been mistaken for a god or saint.
notice: [Halo worn. Legendary class: Crowned in Proof.]
blurb: Follows Divine, the Hidden Shade of Halo, the visible symptom of Divinity, worn more as proof than power.
features: Skill: Proof of Heaven
Your halo sheds light 30 feet, divine beings recognise you, and you have advantage on Persuasion with the faithful.
Skill: Ring Thrown
Throw your halo 60 feet for 6d10 radiant; it returns.
Ultimate: Sign Beyond Doubt
Once per long rest, creatures that see you make a Wis save or treat you as a god for 1 minute, kneeling and refusing to attack.
evolves: If a true god names you, the halo becomes real Divinity.
cost: Your halo cannot be hidden: you always shed light.

requires: Level 12+; the trace Nydoos left on the top floor of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Nydoos left footprints that vanish as fast as they appear. Catch them before they fade.
secret: You must have arrived somewhere before the news of your coming.
notice: [Speed: burning. Legendary class: Sudden-Burn Sprinter.]
blurb: Follows Nydoos, the Hidden Shade of Haste, Speed's sharper cousin that burns out faster than it lasts.
features: Skill: Burst
As a bonus action, Dash and make one attack; your speed drops 10 feet next turn.
Skill: Stagger-Step
As a reaction, weave like a drunkard to impose disadvantage on an attack.
Ultimate: Burn Out Bright
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you have double speed and an extra action each turn, then gain a level of exhaustion.
evolves: If you outrun Speed's holder, the class evolves.
cost: You eat twice as much, burning through it.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Seldoeth's remains from the top floor of the Milestone Spire
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, Seldoeth's remains clench a stone with a name scratched on it. The last trial: tell the remains whom you hate and why, calmly.
secret: You must have kept a grudge for at least three years.
notice: [Grudge settled into stone. Legendary class: Cold-Grudge Brawler.]
blurb: Follows Seldoeth, the Silent Heart of Hate, the hardened form Anger takes once it stops burning.
features: Skill: Settled Anger
Name one hated creature: your hits deal +1d6 to it.
Skill: Grudge Remembered
You have advantage on saves against charm and always know the direction to your hated foe.
Ultimate: Cold Fury
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage and add +1d6 to every hit.
evolves: If your hated foe dies by your hand, choose a new grudge or evolve toward Scorn.
cost: You cannot forgive: you cannot willingly end your grudge.

requires: Level 56+; the trace Life left on the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, one ring measures the Life of every climber, Life's trace. Let it measure you and do not lie about the number.
secret: You must have nursed a sick village back to health.
notice: [Health measured. Legendary class: Keeper of the Full Measure.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Strange Shade of Health, the mortal, bloodline free measure of how much Life a body holds.
features: Skill: Read Vitality
You see the current hit points of creatures, and your healing adds +6d8.
Skill: Measure Exchanged
Once per short rest, swap the hit point percentages of two creatures you touch.
Ultimate: Full Measure
Once per long rest, allies within 120 feet are restored to full hit points and gain 50 temporary hit points.
evolves: If you heal a god, you hold Life's measure itself.
cost: You feel every wound near you: disadvantage on concentration saves in combat.

requires: Level 34+; the trace Aelsaor left on the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, a whisper can only be heard when the floors shift, Aelsaor's trace. Hear where the next floor will be before it moves.
secret: You must have spent time blind.
notice: [Hearing refined. Legendary class: Ear of the Shuffled Halls.]
blurb: Follows Aelsaor, the Nameless Shade of Hearing, the refined sense second only to Vision for Martial cultivators.
features: Skill: Blind Hearing
You have blindsight to 120 feet through sound.
Skill: Heard Before Seen
You cannot be surprised, and invisible creatures gain no advantage against you.
Ultimate: Hear the Heartbeats
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you hear every creature within a mile, and your hits deal +8d10 by striking where heartbeats are loudest.
evolves: If you hear a god speak, the class grows into a sense beyond hearing.
cost: Loud noises stun you for 1 round.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Life's remains from the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, a heart still beats in Life's remains. The last trial: strike it once, exactly, without killing it.
secret: You must have survived a wound to the heart.
notice: [Target: the heart. Legendary class: Heartstriker.]
blurb: Follows Life, the Quiet Shade of Heart, the place a body keeps its Life, which is why losing it ends things fastest.
features: Skill: Strike the Heart
Your attacks score a critical hit on 18 to 20.
Skill: Second Heart
Once per long rest, when you drop to 0 hit points you regain half your maximum.
Ultimate: Stop
Once per long rest, a creature you hit makes a Con save or drops to 0 hit points; on a success it takes 12d10.
evolves: If you strike a god's heart, the class evolves.
cost: Critical hits against you deal maximum damage.

requires: Level 1+; the trace Bravaur left on the top floor of the Milestone Spire
unlock: On the Milestone Spire's top floor lies a letter that was never sent, Bravaur's trace. Read it aloud, then finish it.
secret: Someone you loved must have left you.
notice: [Heartbreak sung. Legendary class: Bard of the Unsent Letter.]
blurb: Follows Bravaur, the Hollow Heart of Heartbreak, what is left of Love once Sadness gets to it.
features: Skill: Sorrow Song
Once per short rest, a creature within 30 feet makes a Wis save or has disadvantage on its next attack and takes 1d6 psychic.
Skill: Voices of the Lost
Once per long rest, you speak with the spirit of someone who died.
Ultimate: Broken-Hearted Ballad
Once per long rest, enemies within 30 feet make a Wis save or are stunned by sorrow for 1 round.
evolves: At level 11, if you love again, the class evolves.
cost: You cannot easily love: disadvantage on Persuasion to form bonds.

requires: Level 23+; the trace Ignis left on the top floor of the Choir Spire
unlock: On the Choir Spire's cold white top floor, one warm spot remains where Ignis left its trace. Meditate there until your breath steams in the light.
secret: You must have walked barefoot across hot coals.
notice: [Heat channelled. Legendary class: Ember-Palm Ascetic.]
blurb: Follows Ignis, the Radiant Spirit of Heat, the barest sliver of Fire, too thin for Ignis's shape but a being of its own.
features: Skill: Ember Palm
Your unarmed hits deal +4d8 fire, and you are immune to heat and fire.
Skill: Heat Shimmer
Once per short rest, a 20 foot aura of heat imposes disadvantage on attacks against you for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Furnace Breath
Once per long rest, a 60 foot cone of heat deals 12d10 fire and melts metal armour.
evolves: If you stand beside Ignis's remains, the class can evolve toward Fire.
cost: Cold weakens you: you have vulnerability to cold.

requires: Level 56+; a piece of Orsath's remains from the top floor of the Heartwood Spire
unlock: At the top of the Heartwood Spire, Orsath's remains are overgrown with every herb. The last trial: brew a potion from them that heals the tree itself.
secret: You must have identified a hundred different herbs.
notice: [Herb lore complete. Legendary class: Root-Wise Apothecary.]
blurb: Follows Orsath, the Nameless Shade of Herb, the Nature adjacent raw material Alchemy starts from.
features: Skill: Herb Lore
You brew potions in a short rest, and your potions heal +6d8.
Skill: Bitter Root
Your poisons deal 10d8 and ignore resistance.
Ultimate: Grand Remedy
Once per long rest, a potion cures every curse, disease and condition in creatures within 60 feet.
evolves: If you cultivate a herb from a god's remains, the class becomes Alchemy's peak.
cost: You must forage each day or lose your stock.

requires: Level 34+; the trace Orkais left on the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, a hollow suit of armour that Orkais left is always on the next floor. Catch it and climb inside.
secret: Your soul or memories must have been taken once.
notice: [Essence: absent. Legendary class: Husk-Walker.]
blurb: Follows Orkais, the Quiet Shade of Hollow, what is left once Essence has been taken.
features: Skill: Empty Shell
You resist psychic and necrotic damage, and cannot be possessed.
Skill: Hollow Step
Teleport between shadows within 60 feet as a bonus action.
Ultimate: Draw Out
Once per long rest, a creature makes a Cha save or its essence is hollowed: it is stunned for 1 minute and takes 10d10 necrotic each turn.
evolves: If you fill your hollow with something worthy, the class evolves toward Fill.
cost: You feel little: disadvantage on Insight.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Ulvayr left on the top floor of the Unlit Spire
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, where every floor below is forgotten, Ulvayr's trace is a hand reaching upward. Keep reaching for something you cannot see, with no memory of why.
secret: You must have kept going when all allies urged you to give up.
notice: [Hope sustained. Legendary class: Reacher for the Far Shore.]
blurb: Follows Ulvayr, the Tender Heart of Hope, Happiness's sibling under Light, reaching rather than resting.
features: Skill: Reaching Hand
Allies within 60 feet who drop to 0 hit points regain 8d10 instead once per short rest each.
Skill: Not Yet Lost
Allies within 60 feet cannot be frightened and have advantage on death saves.
Ultimate: Far Shore
Once per long rest, all allies within a mile are fully healed and revived for 1 minute even if dead.
evolves: If your hope carries someone to the Primordial, the class evolves.
cost: Despair stalls you: if all allies fall, you are stunned for a round.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Nyzeael's remains from the top floor of the Choir Spire
unlock: At the top of the Choir Spire, Nyzeael's horned skull still sings with the choir. The last trial: charge the choir head-on and break through its wall of sound.
secret: You must have broken a bone and kept fighting.
notice: [Horns grown. Legendary class: Bone-Crowned Charger.]
blurb: Follows Nyzeael, the Quiet Shade of Horn, the body Law of growing a weapon from bone for charging and goring.
features: Skill: Grown Horns
You grow horns that deal 3d10 piercing and regrow if broken.
Skill: Gore Charge
Move 30 feet straight and gore for +6d8, knocking the target prone.
Ultimate: Crown of Bone
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your horns grow huge: +2 AC, and each charge hits every creature in your path for 12d10.
evolves: If you gore a beast god, the class evolves.
cost: Your horns cannot be hidden, and helmets will not fit.

requires: Level 12+; the trace Varais left on the top floor of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Varais left a cup of blood in a mirror that never dries. Drink only from it for a week.
secret: You must have survived losing most of your blood.
notice: [Feeding sustained. Legendary class: Night-Fed Wanderer.]
blurb: Follows Varais, the Nameless Shade of Hupia, a blood drinker that keeps its power while it feeds, like the night-walking dead of island tales.
features: Skill: Blood Kept
Your bite deals 2d8 piercing and heals you equal to the damage.
Skill: Night Walk
You have darkvision 120 feet and walk unseen at night.
Ultimate: Crimson Fill
Once per long rest, drain a creature: it makes a Con save or loses 6d10 hit points and you gain double that as temporary hit points.
evolves: If you feed only on the willing for a year, the class evolves.
cost: You must drink blood each day or lose a tenth of your power.

requires: Level 1+; a piece of Vasaor's remains from the top floor of the Milestone Spire
unlock: At the top of the Milestone Spire, Vasaor's remains clutch a plain club. The last trial: strike the training post a thousand times with no technique at all.
secret: You must never have used a special maneuver or spell in a fight.
notice: [Hurt confirmed. Legendary class: Plain-Blow Champion.]
blurb: Follows Vasaor, the Forgotten Shade of Hurt, the plainest offensive Law, doing exactly what it says.
features: Skill: Simple Hurt
Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on 19 or 20.
Skill: Plain Truth
Your hits ignore damage resistance.
Ultimate: Just Hit It
Once per long rest, your next hit deals maximum damage.
evolves: At level 11, a thousand plain kills can evolve the class.
cost: You cannot use maneuvers, stances or fancy techniques.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Undine's remains from the top floor of the Hollow Spire
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Undine's remains are frozen into glowing ice. The last trial: break the ice without fire.
secret: You must have survived freezing.
notice: [Ice channelled. Legendary class: Frostwall Abjurer.]
blurb: Follows Undine, the Hidden Shade of Ice, the changed form of Water drawn from Undine's dying corpse.
features: Skill: Frost Ward
You and allies within 30 feet resist cold, and hits against you deal 10d8 cold to the attacker.
Skill: Ice Wall
