Once per short rest, raise a 120 foot wall of ice with 200 hit points.
Ultimate: Glacier
Once per long rest, freeze a 120 foot area for 1 minute: creatures make a Con save or are restrained in ice taking 16d10 cold each turn.
evolves: If you thaw Undine's remains, the class evolves.
cost: Heat harms you: you have vulnerability to fire.

requires: Level 78+; a piece of Aelleeth's remains from the top floor of the Hollow Spire
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Aelleeth's remains are a statue of someone about to act. State your ideal aloud and let the Void test it with silence.
secret: You must never have broken your stated ideal.
notice: [Ideal held. Legendary class: Bearer of the Unspent Vow.]
blurb: Follows Aelleeth, the Nameless Shade of Ideals, what a Sin or virtue looks like before a mortal acts on it.
features: Skill: Unacted Strength
While you act in line with your ideal, you gain +2 AC and +6d10 on hits.
Skill: Ideal Shield
Allies within 30 feet who share your ideal resist all damage.
Ultimate: Pure Intent
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your ideal becomes Law within 120 feet: creatures that act against it take 20d10 radiant.
evolves: If you act on your ideal at the cost of your life, the class evolves.
cost: Breaking your ideal strips this class for a month.

requires: Level 34+; a piece of Selkayr's remains from the top floor of the Shuffled Spire
unlock: At the top of the Shuffled Spire, Selkayr's remains lie among a hundred identical corpses. The last trial: identify the true one.
secret: You must have unmasked an impostor.
notice: [Identity confirmed. Legendary class: True-Name Examiner.]
blurb: Follows Selkayr, the Twin-Faced Shade of Identify, used to tell Friend from Foe and a real god from one wearing a stolen Law.
features: Skill: True Sight of Names
You learn any creature's true name and type when you see it.
Skill: Unmask
Once per short rest, end a disguise, possession or stolen Law within 60 feet.
Ultimate: Known for What It Is
Once per long rest, name a creature: for 1 minute its features and resistances do not work against you.
evolves: If you identify a false god, the class evolves.
cost: Lies hurt you: you take 1d6 psychic whenever you are lied to.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Ignis's remains from the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, a campfire on the open plain is Ignis's last ember. The last trial: feed it something you love and sit in its warmth until dawn.
secret: You must have kept a fire burning through a winter for others.
notice: [Hunger and warmth. Legendary class: Hearth-Hunger Wanderer.]
blurb: Follows Ignis, the progenitor spirit of Fire, hungry rather than cruel, consuming all it touched and giving warmth as freely as it destroyed.
features: Skill: Hungry Flame
Your fire damage ignores resistance and heals you for half.
Skill: Shared Warmth
Allies within 60 feet regain 6d10 hit points at the start of their turns while you burn.
Ultimate: Consuming Hearth
Once per long rest, a 120 foot area burns for 1 minute: 14d10 fire to enemies each round and full warmth to allies.
evolves: Carry the ember to the First Spire and the class may evolve into Ashborn Sovereign.
cost: You must burn something of value each week.

requires: Level 12+; a piece of Mortaos's remains from the top floor of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Mortaos's corpse is the only thing in the mirrored room without a reflection. The last trial: find it.
secret: You must have fooled a divination spell.
notice: [Illusion mastered. Legendary class: Mirror-Mist Deceiver.]
blurb: Follows Mortaos, the Twice-Born Keeper of Illusion, built from False the way Fire is built from Ignis.
features: Skill: Mirror Twin
As a bonus action, create an illusory double; attacks against you have a 50 percent chance to hit it instead.
Skill: Fog of Seeming
Once per short rest, a 30 foot area fills with illusions that impose disadvantage on attacks.
Ultimate: Thousand Mirrors
Once per long rest, enemies within 60 feet make a Wis save or are lost in mirrors for 1 minute.
evolves: If you fool a god, the class evolves toward False.
cost: You see your reflection wrong: disadvantage on Insight.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Bratheor's remains from the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Bratheor's remains are a portrait that looks like whoever views it. The last trial: paint yourself so well the portrait copies you.
secret: You must have been painted or sculpted from life.
notice: [Image copied. Legendary class: Painter of Living Likeness.]
blurb: Follows Bratheor, the Forgotten Shade of Image, a copy of appearance only, thinner than Illusion.
features: Skill: Likeness
Take any creature's appearance perfectly.
Skill: Painted Double
Once per short rest, paint a living image that fights for 1 minute with your stats at half hit points.
Ultimate: Gallery of Selves
Once per long rest, create six images for 1 minute; each deals 6d10 on hits.
evolves: If your image outlives you, the class passes into it.
cost: You forget your own face over time.

requires: Level 78+; the trace Ostmin left on the top floor of the Hollow Spire
unlock: At the top of the Hollow Spire, Ostmin left a scar on the nothing. Endure each damage type in turn, without rest.
secret: You must have survived poison or disease that killed others.
notice: [Immunity earned. Legendary class: The Inured One.]
blurb: Follows Ostmin, the Shrouded Shade of Immunity, a narrower and permanent Resistance earned rather than cast.
features: Skill: Earned Immunity
Choose two damage types; you are immune to them.
Skill: Unbowed Body
You are immune to poison, disease and exhaustion.
Ultimate: Untouchable
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you are immune to all damage from one source.
evolves: If you survive a god's strike, gain another immunity.
cost: Healing works at half on you.

requires: Level 89+; the trace Vesniur left on the top floor of the Unlit Spire
unlock: At the top of the Unlit Spire, an empty cell with broken chains bears Vesniur's trace. Lock yourself in and hold the door from inside until you remember why.
secret: You must have served as a jailer for a year.
notice: [Prison ready. Legendary class: Warden of the God-Cell.]
blurb: Follows Vesniur, the Shrouded Shade of Imprison, Cage and Chain combined, strong enough to hold real power.
features: Skill: Chained
Your hits restrain the target (Str save).
Skill: Cage
Once per short rest, a 30 foot cage of force holds creatures inside.
Ultimate: Imprison Divine
Once per long rest, imprison a creature for 1 hour; even gods must make a Cha save.
evolves: If you hold a god for a day, the class evolves.
cost: You cannot stand open spaces: disadvantage outdoors.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Ultaeth's remains from the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Ultaeth's remains are a statue polished by countless hands. The last trial: improve it.
secret: You must have trained every day for a year.
notice: [Improvement locked in. Legendary class: Oathbearer of Small Gains.]
blurb: Follows Ultaeth, the Strange Shade of Improvement, Boost's cousin, slower but longer lasting.
features: Skill: Daily Gain
Each long rest, gain +1 to one roll type, max +5.
Skill: Lasting Boost
Your buffs on allies last 1 hour.
Ultimate: Glorious Improvement
Once per long rest, all allies within 120 feet gain +2 AC and +10d10 on hits for 1 hour.
evolves: After a year of daily gains, the class evolves.
cost: Skipping training loses all gains.

requires: Level 67+; a piece of Infinatas's remains from the top floor of the Horizon Spire
unlock: At the top of the Horizon Spire, Infinatas's shadow falls backward, Inane's killed half. The last trial: destroy something you made, to keep the balance.
secret: You must have destroyed something you made with your own hands.
notice: [Balance: destruction. Legendary class: Other Face of Balance.]
blurb: Follows Infinatas, the Shrouded Shade of Inane, Infinatas's split personality that keeps balance through Destruction.
features: Skill: Unmake
Your hits deal +8d10 force to constructs and creations.
Skill: Balance Restored
Once per short rest, end a spell or creation within 120 feet.
Ultimate: Inane Turn
Once per long rest, destroy a creation of any size within 300 feet; creatures take 20d10 force.
evolves: If you meet Infinatas and he does not turn away, the class evolves.
cost: For every thing you destroy, you must create something of equal value.

requires: Level 23+; a piece of Ostdoel's remains from the top floor of the Ledger Spire
unlock: At the top of the Ledger Spire, Ostdoel's remains were never struck directly. The last trial: hit a target you cannot see.
secret: You must have won a fight without a direct hit.
notice: [Indirect confirmed. Legendary class: Scatter-Shot Strategist.]
blurb: Follows Ostdoel, the Quiet Shade of Indirect, trading accuracy for reach or spread.
features: Skill: Ricochet
Your attacks ignore cover and can bounce around corners.
Skill: Spread
Once per short rest, a single-target spell or attack hits all creatures in a 20 foot radius.
Ultimate: Rain of Indirection
Once per long rest, a 120 foot area takes 10d10 force each round for 1 minute.
evolves: If you strike a god without aim, the class evolves.
cost: Direct shots fail: disadvantage on single-target attacks.

requires: Level 12+; an audience with Infinatas at the top of the Fogglass Spire
unlock: At the top of the Fogglass Spire, Infinatas himself waits in the mist. Meet him and answer what you would keep and what you would let end.
secret: You must have created and destroyed something of equal worth in one day.
notice: [Audience granted. Legendary class: Guest of the Balance.]
blurb: Follows Infinatas, the Creator of All, the Balance Itself, one of the last original gods who was never broken.
features: Skill: Balanced Hand
Your healing and damage both increase by 2d8.
Skill: Weigh
Once per short rest, set a creature's hit points to the average of yours and its.
Ultimate: The Balance Itself
